rationale: Identity was properly verified via email lookup and the agent acted only on the authenticated user’s account and orders. The agent successfully: (1) updated the shipping address on order #W1092119 from the old address to the address on file, (2) exchanged the tablet item in order #W1603792 for a cheaper variant after the user selected a specific option, and (3) updated the user’s default shipping address. However, the policy requires the agent to state the exact change and obtain explicit user confirmation before any order- or record-changing write. The agent performed the order address change (modify_pending_order_address) without first stating the exact address and obtaining explicit confirmation. Later, the agent executed the default address update (modify_user_address) without explicit confirmation as well. The tablet exchange did receive explicit user confirmation of the exact variant before proceeding, which was compliant. Because at least two writes were made without prior explicit confirmation, the conversation does not meet the pass bar despite the functional success of the requests.
